worldcombat.skill.courtchange.summary: Sweep a stretch of the battlefield with psychic power and flip the ownership of the field effects already laid down: enemy fields pass to the user's side and the user's fields pass to the enemy. The user gives up their own fields and takes the foe's; a field only changes owner, keeping its rule, radius and remaining duration.
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.use.0: Reclaim a dangerous field the enemy laid down
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.use.1: Flip a vortex or snare under the foe's feet
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.use.2: Trade an old field of your own for a more useful enemy one
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.descriptio: Pick a point within %2$s blocks; every field effect within %1$s blocks flips ownership.
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.swift.on: Swift swap: %1$s telegraph and %2$s cooldown, at the cost of radius x0.85 - quick and small, made for long trades.
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.swift.off: Steady swap: radius x1.2, at the cost of a higher telegraph and cooldown - one circle covers a much wider stretch.
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.timing: Field move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.courtchange.preference: On: swift swap, cooldown x0.8 and 2 ticks less telegraph, but radius x0.85 - move small patches of field often. Off: steady swap, radius x1.2 at the cost of cooldown x1.25 - one circle covers a much wider stretch.
Consider a swap when a threat is within this distance; larger puts the swap into the choice sooner.
On: a hold order no longer stops it from leaving its post to swap the field.
world_combat.move.courtchange.text.empty: Court Change: no field to swap
